questions.question: What capability does the integration of Collaborative Work Management (CWM) with Portfolio Planning provide?

options.text: The ability to plan and roadmap with Boards as planning items in a portfolio plan
Direct integration with external project management tools
Automated resource allocation across all projects

explanation.correct: With the integration of ServiceNow Collaborative Work Management (CWM) with Portfolio Planning, you can plan and roadmap with Boards in a portfolio plan. By adding CWM Boards to a lens configuration, you can access them in the Prioritization and Roadmap pages of a portfolio plan as planning items.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incident creation is not part of the CWM-Portfolio Planning integration
This integration is internal to ServiceNow applications, not external tools
Resource allocation is managed through Resource Management, not this specific integration

source.excerpt: With the integration of ServiceNow Collaborative Work Management (CWM) with Portfolio Planning, you can plan and roadmap with Boards in a portfolio plan.

questions.question: Which lenses are supported when configuring CWM Board as a planning item in Portfolio Planning?

explanation.correct: The lenses supported to configure CWM Board as a planning item in Portfolio Planning are Organization and Project Portfolio.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Strategic Investments is supported in Strategic Planning, not Portfolio Planning for CWM boards
Business Capability is used for Enterprise Architecture integration, not CWM in Portfolio Planning
Resource and Financial are not lens types for CWM Board configuration

source.excerpt: The lenses supported to configure CMW Board as a planning item are Organization and Project Portfolio.

questions.question: Which ServiceNow applications integrate with Strategic Planning in the Strategic Planning Workspace? (Choose THREE)

explanation.correct: Strategic Planning integrates with CWM for board-based planning, Digital Product Release Workspace for product release management, and Enterprise Architecture Workspace for business capability-based planning.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incident Management is an ITSM application that does not integrate with Strategic Planning
HR Service Delivery is not part of the Strategic Planning integration ecosystem

source.excerpt: Integration of Strategic Planning with other ServiceNow applications helps portfolio and product managers to optimize planning, collaboration, and release management.

questions.question: What does the Digital Product lens enable product managers to do in Strategic Planning?

options.text: Plan, prioritize, and roadmap work for digital products by aligning with business strategy
Automatically generate project budgets from product sales data
Create automated test plans for digital products

explanation.correct: Using the Digital Product lens, product managers can plan, prioritize, and roadmap the work for digital products by aligning with the business strategy.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incident escalation is an ITSM function, not part of Strategic Planning
Budget generation from sales data is not a feature of the Digital Product lens
Test plan creation is handled by Test Management, not Strategic Planning

source.excerpt: Using the Digital Product lens, product managers can plan, prioritize, and roadmap the work for digital products by aligning with the business strategy.

questions.question: Which lenses are supported for configuring CWM Boards as planning items in Strategic Planning? (Choose THREE)

explanation.correct: The lenses supported to configure CWM Board as a planning item in Strategic Planning are Organization, Project Portfolio, and Strategic Investments.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Business Capability lens is used for Enterprise Architecture integration, not CWM Board configuration
Financial is not a lens type for CWM Board configuration in Strategic Planning

source.excerpt: The lenses supported to configure CMW Board as a planning item are Organization, Project Portfolio, and Strategic Investments.

questions.question: What benefit does integrating Digital Portfolio Management (DPM) with Strategic Planning provide?

options.text: Automatic generation of incident reports from portfolio data
Access to roadmap planning for monitoring services and making informed budgetary decisions
Replacement of all existing financial management tools
Automated assignment of resources to all portfolio items

explanation.correct: Integrating DPM with Strategic Planning provides DPM managers access to roadmap planning, allowing them to optimize portfolio performance by monitoring services and making informed budgetary decisions by prioritizing backlogs and managing roadmaps of business applications.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incident reporting is not part of the DPM-Strategic Planning integration
DPM integration complements financial tools, it does not replace them
Resource assignment automation is not a feature of this integration

source.excerpt: Integrate Digital Portfolio Management (DPM) with Strategic Planning to provide DPM managers the access to roadmap planning.

questions.question: An enterprise architect wants to plan and prioritize work based on business capabilities using Strategic Planning. Which lens should they use?

explanation.correct: Using the Business Capability lens, enterprise architects can plan, prioritize, and roadmap the work based on the business capabilities or business applications through the Enterprise Architecture Workspace integration.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The Digital Product lens is used by product managers for digital product work, not enterprise architecture
The Organization lens is for organizational-level planning, not specifically for business capability-based work
The Project Portfolio lens is for portfolio-level planning, not for business capability-based architectural planning

source.excerpt: Using the Business Capability lens, enterprise architects can plan, prioritize, and roadmap the work based on the business capabilities or business applications.

questions.question: When CWM Boards are added to Strategic Planning, on which pages can they be accessed as planning items? (Choose THREE)

explanation.correct: By adding CWM Boards to a lens configuration in Strategic Planning, you can access them in the Prioritization, Roadmap, and Goals pages of a portfolio plan as planning items.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Resource Allocation is managed through Resource Management, not through CWM Board integration
Financial Summary is not one of the pages where CWM Boards appear as planning items

source.excerpt: you can plan, roadmap, and associate goals to Boards in a portfolio plan. By adding CWM Boards to a lens configuration, you can access them in the Prioritization, Roadmap, and Goals pages.

questions.question: How does SPM integrate with ITSM Change Management?

options.text: Project tasks can automatically generate change requests for implementation
Change requests replace project tasks entirely
SPM and ITSM use separate databases with no integration
Only incidents can be linked to projects

explanation.correct: SPM integrates with ITSM by allowing project tasks to generate change requests, ensuring that project implementations follow proper change management governance.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Change requests complement project tasks; they don't replace them
SPM and ITSM share the same platform and integrate natively
Both change requests and incidents can be linked to projects
